title: Ignite #274 (Brian Bell) — Eric: 'AI is an amplifier. Whatever problems you had before, you're going to have much worse with AI.'
summary: Brian Bell — host of the Ignite Podcast (Team Ignite Ventures) — drops a launch-week episode framing Incorruptible as a direct attack on the incentives driving modern corporate behavior, with Eric pinning AI's role as an amplifier of existing governance problems.
blockquote: AI is an amplifier. Whatever problems you had before, you're going to have much worse with AI.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on the Ignite Podcast
attribution_title: Conversations on Startups, Venture Capital, Tech, Future, and Society — hosted by Brian Bell
